==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Elf Nova and I used a portal spell to cross a dark abyss. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Elf Nova resembles a floating, ghostly, purple, hologram of an elf woman with long blonde hair wearing a crop top made of green foliage, white bell bottom pants, and brown boots.) (The dark abyss resembles a large canyon shrouded in a magical menacing dark fog. There is a brown wooden rope bridge that connects both sides, but it doesn't look safe to cross.) (Porta is the portal spell I used to cross the dark abyss.)
We end up on an island swarmed with abyssal demons who are strong enough to crack my divine shield. (The abyssal demons resembled tangible living shadows with glowing red eyes and pale white horns.) (Aegis is the divine shield spell I used. The Aegis shield resembles a glowing green barrier covered in a neon white honeycomb pattern.)
We are forced to retreat using the portal spell. (The abyssal demons didn't even try to follow us, as they seem bound to the dark island.)
